why: A (universes 0) gives these results for a proper covering F. (1) d_𝐘(φ) = d_{𝐗ₛ×_F Y}(Lφ) and d_𝐗(Fφ) = d_𝐘(φ). (2) In general only d_{𝐗×Y}(Fφ, sφ) ≤ 2d_𝐘(φ). (3) The equalities d_{𝐗×Y}(Fφ, sφ) = 2d_𝐘(φ) and 2d_{𝐗ₛ×_F Y} = d_{𝐗×Y} only for tame X and Y. A also has Part I's d_{X×Y} ≤ d_X + d_Y, the tame product formula (isTame_prod) and Proposition 2.24. B claims the product formula d_{𝐗×Y}(φ,y) = d_𝐗(φ) + d_Y(y) for all points with no tameness, and with it (d) and (e). The project's degeneracy index (Definition 2.22) is the minimum over all charts of the structure. Product charts give ≤, but non-product charts of 𝐗×Y might give smaller values. Without tameness we have neither a proof of = nor a counterexample, so A_to_B fails on exactly (b), (d) and (e). This would need new mathematics on non-tame degeneracy indices, and may not hold. With X.IsTame and Y.IsTame added (BTame), A → BTame is proved: (b) from isTame_prod, using that 𝐗 is tame because s is a local sc-diffeomorphism. So tameness is the only difference. B_to_A reads the four proper-covering conjuncts off B (subPolyfold does not depend on the proof hA, and the paracompactness instances are Props). It re-proves Part I's three general lemmas outright by copying the project's proofs, since B does not imply them.
overlap: B_to_A: 462 shared project theorems. Most are M-polyfold, product and sub-M-polyfold infrastructure reached through the statements (the IsSubMPolyfold.data and fibredSubDataL proof fields, prod, subPolyfold). The rest are the lemmas used by the copied Part I proofs: exists_isChart_degIndex_eq, chartDegIndex_prod, degIndex_le, IsChart.prod, IsTame.exists_chart, prod_eq_prodPresentation, IsTameWith.prod, degIndex_eq_chartDegIndex_of_isTameWith, isTame_of_forall_exists_chart and degIndex_le_of_isScDiffeoOn, the same as the project's proofs. A_to_BTame also passes plain #rt_check; it uses A's proposition_2_24 for d_Y(sφ) = d_𝐘(φ) instead of the project's EpGroupoid.degIndex_src, which is built on it.
intended: BTame (B with X.IsTame, Y.IsTame added): A_to_BTame proved, plain #rt_check OK, uses A; B_to_BTame is immediate.
